description: Physics-based character movement built on Mover 2.0 — Epic's Chaos Mover. Adds a UChaosCharacterMoverComponent (auto-selects the Chaos physics backend with Walking/Falling/Flying modes) and tunes its shared physics settings. Requires UE 5.6+, the Mover + Chaos Mover plugins, and two project-wide physics settings (Project Settings > Engine - Physics: Tick Physics Async + Physics Prediction) — Chaos characters stay frozen until you enable those and restart the editor; the tools report this requirement but do not change project config for you. Per-mode physics tuning and mode add/remove reuse the 'mover' umbrella.
